name: Interior Drywall Wall RP Prep
intent: Condition-driven prep: wash/clean, sand/scuff (sound) or scrape (failing), fill/patch, dust cleanup.
doctrine: Condition-driven prep. Scraping at 80 SF/hr baseline with condition modifier (GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x). Sand/scuff fires for sound paint, scrape fires for failing paint. All rates at QT3 baseline.
